What the page says

  • Technology: intelligent automation
  • Minimum deposit: min $250
  • Asset class: bonds
  • Payment methods: e-wallets
  • Withdrawal: withdrawal within 24h
  • Registration fee: no registration fee
  • Support: 24/7 support

What we could not check

We have not run regulator or security-database checks on this platform for this review. The page does not name a regulator, licence or company.
